title: Artifact Lifecycle 360: Build, Store, Scan, Attest, Deploy
subtitle: End-to-end artifact story across CI, Artifact Registry, Supply Chain Security, STO, Policy as Code and CD: how many artifacts were built, stored, scanned, attested and deployed, the conversion between stages, and the gaps (never scanned, never deployed, deployed without SBOM/signature, policy errors).

widget.text: # Artifact Lifecycle 360: Build → Store → Scan → Attest → Deploy

**What this shows:** every artifact's journey across CI (built), Artifact Registry (stored: uploads/pulls), Supply Chain Security (registered, SBOM, signing, provenance), STO (security scans) and Policy as Code (governance), ending in CD (deployed). **How stages are joined:** the pipeline *plan execution id* links CI, STO, OPA, CD and SCS creation/SBOM/scan executions; the image *digest* links SCS artifacts to STO scans (`sha256:` + fingerprint) and to AR Docker versions (version = `01` + digest); the image *name:tag* links SCS artifacts to CD deployments. Where no join exists, stage counts are shown side by side. **How to use:** Organization/Project/Pipeline apply to every module; Service/Environment narrow CD; Artifact Type narrows SCS; Registry narrows AR. Tabs go from the funnel to per-stage deep dives, risk gaps and per-artifact traceability. Execution IDs and artifact URLs are clickable.

cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and x.start_ts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) and x.artifact_display_name != "" | select { x.artifact_display_name as nt, count() as deps, distinct_count(x.env_name) as envs, max(x.start_ts) as last_dep } | group_by x.artifact_display_name), f as (find saf | left join ar on ar.dg = saf.dg | left join dep on dep.nt = saf.nt | select { 1 as k, count() as total, sum(case when saf.comps > 0 then 1 else 0 end) as sbom, sum(case when saf.sto_pe != "" then 1 else 0 end) as scanned, sum(case when ar.dg is null then 0 else 1 end) as stored, sum(case when dep.nt is null then 0 else 1 end) as deployed, sum(case when saf.sig != "" then 1 else 0 end) as signed }) find dim | join f on f.k = dim.k | filter dim.rn <= 6 | select { case when dim.rn = 1 then "1 Registered" when dim.rn = 2 then "2 SBOM" when dim.rn = 3 then "3 Vuln-scanned" when dim.rn = 4 then "4 Stored in AR" when dim.rn = 5 then "5 Deployed" else "6 Signed" end as stage, case when dim.rn = 1 then f.total when dim.rn = 2 then f.sbom when dim.rn = 3 then f.scanned when dim.rn = 4 then f.stored when dim.rn = 5 then f.deployed else f.signed end as artifacts } | order_by stage asc

queries.query: with u as (find view "ar:view:audit_event" z | filter z.timestamp >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and z.timestamp <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) and ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} and ${registry_filter_predicate} and z.action = "UPLOAD" | select { z.registry_name as reg, z.package_name as pk, z.version_name as v, min(z.timestamp) as up, count() as ups } | group_by z.registry_name, z.package_name, z.version_name), dl as (find view "ar:view:audit_event" e | filter e.action = "DOWNLOAD" and e.timestamp >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and e.timestamp <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | select { e.registry_name as reg, e.package_name as pk, e.version_name as v, min(e.timestamp) as dn, count() as downs } | group_by e.registry_name, e.package_name, e.version_name) find u | left join dl on dl.reg = u.reg and dl.pk = u.pk and dl.v = u.v | select { u.reg as registry, u.pk as package, count() as versions, sum(u.ups) as uploads, sum(case when dl.downs is null then 0 else dl.downs end) as pulls, sum(case when dl.v is null then 0 else 1 end) as versions_pulled, round(sum(case when dl.v is null then 0 else 1 end) * 100.0 / count(), 1) as pct_consumed, avg(case when dl.dn is null then null else date_diff(u.up, dl.dn, "second") end) as avg_first_pull, max(u.up) as last_upload } | group_by u.reg, u.pk | order_by versions desc

queries.query: with sg as (find entity "ssca:artifact" a | select { a.digest as dg, max(a.name) as name, max(a.tag) as tag, max(concat(a.name, ":", a.tag)) as nt, max(a.sbom_component_count) as comps, max(a.sto_critical) as crit, max(a.sto_high) as high, max(a.url) as url } | group_by a.digest), dep as (find view "cd:deployment_stage_execution" x | filter x.start_ts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and x.start_ts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) and x.artifact_display_name != "" | select { x.artifact_display_name as nt, count() as deps, distinct_count(x.env_name) as envs, max(x.start_ts) as last_dep } | group_by x.artifact_display_name), u as (find view "ar:view:audit_event" z | filter z.timestamp >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and z.timestamp <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) and ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} and ${registry_filter_predicate} and z.action = "UPLOAD" and z.package_type = "DOCKER" | select { z.registry_name as registry, z.package_name as package, concat("sha256:", substring(z.version_name, 3)) as dg, substring(z.version_name, 3, 12) as digest_short, count() as uploads, min(z.timestamp) as uploaded } | group_by z.registry_name, z.package_name, concat("sha256:", substring(z.version_name, 3)), substring(z.version_name, 3, 12)) find u | left join sg on sg.dg = u.dg | left join dep on dep.nt = sg.nt | filter dep.nt is null | select { u.registry as registry, u.package as package, u.digest_short as digest, u.uploads as uploads, case when sg.dg is null then false else true end as tracked_in_scs, u.uploaded as uploaded } | order_by uploaded desc

queries.query: with saf as (find entity "ssca:artifact" a | left join view "view:pipeline:pipeline_execution" z on z.plan_execution_id = a.creation_pipeline_execution_id | filter a.last_activity_at >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and a.last_activity_at <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) and ${org_filter_predicate} and ${project_filter_predicate} and ${pipeline_filter_predicate} and ${atype_filter_predicate} | select { a.name as name, a.tag as tag, a.digest as dg, concat(a.name, ":", a.tag) as nt, a.type as type, a.url as url, a.commit_sha as commit_sha, a.repository_name as repository, a.sbom_component_count as comps, a.sto_critical as crit, a.sto_high as high, a.sto_medium as med, a.sto_low as low, a.signing_verification_status as sig, a.provenance_status as provenance, a.sto_pipeline_execution_id as sto_pe, a.created_at as created, a.creation_pipeline_execution_id as exec_id, z.org_identifier as org, z.project_identifier as project, z.pipeline_identifier as pipeline }), ar as (find view "ar:view:audit_event" e | filter e.package_type = "DOCKER" and e.timestamp >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and e.timestamp <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | select { concat("sha256:", substring(e.version_name, 3)) as dg, sum(case when e.action = "UPLOAD" then 1 else 0 end) as ups, sum(case when e.action = "DOWNLOAD" then 1 else 0 end) as downs } | group_by concat("sha256:", substring(e.version_name, 3))), dep as (find view "cd:deployment_stage_execution" x | filter x.start_ts >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and x.start_ts <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) and x.artifact_display_name != "" | select { x.artifact_display_name as nt, count() as deps, distinct_count(x.env_name) as envs, max(x.start_ts) as last_dep } | group_by x.artifact_display_name), sd as (find view "view:sto:scan" s | filter s.is_deleted = false and s.artifact_fingerprint != "" and s.created >= cast(${start_time} as timestamp) and s.created <= cast(${end_time} as timestamp) | select { concat("sha256:", s.artifact_fingerprint) as dg, count() as scans } | group_by concat("sha256:", s.artifact_fingerprint)) find saf | left join ar on ar.dg = saf.dg | left join dep on dep.nt = saf.nt | left join sd on sd.dg = saf.dg | select { saf.type as type, saf.name as artifact, saf.tag as tag, saf.project as project, saf.pipeline as pipeline, saf.exec_id as exec_id, saf.org as org, saf.commit_sha as commit, saf.repository as repository, case when saf.sto_pe != "" or sd.dg is not null then true else false end as scanned, saf.crit as critical, saf.high as high, saf.med as medium, saf.low as low, saf.comps as sbom_components, case when saf.sig != "" then true else false end as signed, saf.provenance as provenance, case when ar.ups is null then 0 else ar.ups end as ar_uploads, case when ar.downs is null then 0 else ar.downs end as ar_pulls, case when dep.deps is null then 0 else dep.deps end as deployments, case when dep.envs is null then 0 else dep.envs end as environments, saf.url as url, saf.created as registered } | order_by registered desc
